llmNotes: Primary public machine-readable endpoints are /api/public/site, /api/support/search, /sitemap.xml, /api/sitemap.xml, /.well-known/ucp, and /.well-known/mcp.
Home-page service sections live at /#small-events and /#for-businesses; those are anchors on the home document, not standalone pages.
Event booking with instant estimates and deposits lives at /book.
Some checkout flows are JS-enhanced and may continue into hosted checkout after the public landing page.
Form endpoints include a honeypot field named 'website'; leave it empty or omit it, otherwise the submission is silently discarded.

Agents shopping on a human's behalf: read the 'How to buy' section of /llms.txt — browse GET /api/store/products, then either link the human to /sale or /psyche, or create a UCP checkout session and hand them the continue_url.
